# Stormpower Generators Inc.

> Stormpower Generators Inc., a division of PTM Electric, Inc., provides home standby generator installation and start-up, annual maintenance plans, and service and repairs. Licensed Electrical Contractor EC13004084. Based in Loxahatchee, Florida.

## Contact

- Phone (call or text): 561-225-2535
- Email: paul@stormpowergenerators.com
- Address: 16971 W. Hialeah Dr, Loxahatchee, FL 33470
- Website: https://stormpowergenerators.com/

## Service area

Broward, Palm Beach, Martin and St. Lucie counties. City pages: Boca Raton, Delray Beach, West Palm Beach, Wellington, Jupiter, Palm Beach Gardens (Palm Beach County); Parkland, Coral Springs (Broward County); Stuart (Martin County).

## Services

- Installation and start-up of standby generator systems, with permitting and commissioning
- Annual maintenance plans (one Minor and one Major visit per year)
- Service and repairs: diagnostics, repairs and storm response, including transfer switch diagnostics
- Optional 24/7 remote monitoring add-on
- Financing available through Synchrony (Stormpower Generators does not make credit decisions)

## Brands serviced

Generac, Kohler, and Briggs & Stratton standby systems.

## Annual maintenance plan prices (by generator size)

Up-front annual pricing that includes both minor and major service visits:

- 7 kW – 20 kW: $499
- 22 kW – 26 kW: $549
- 27 kW – 30 kW: $649
- 32 kW – 48 kW: $699
- 60 kW – 100 kW: $799

24/7 remote monitoring: $99/year, available as an add-on to any annual maintenance plan.

Included with plans: priority status during storms and after-hours calls, maintenance to manufacturer guidelines, preferred rates on labor and parts outside the agreement, and a free system inspection with any maintenance appointment.

## Licenses

- Licensed Electrical Contractor EC13004084 (Florida)
- Licensed and insured
